official_name.value: International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)

agreement_scope_raw.value: media IMAN sent an email sept 20

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel Col F notes 'media IMAN sent an email sept 20'; media/journalism/communication at AUC maps to GAPP (JRMC), verify current agreement scope with OIP.

eligible_majors.notes: Excel Col F notes 'media IMAN sent an email sept 20'; Interpreting & Translation labs at IULM require foreign language/translation majors (fact sheet p.9).

excluded_majors.notes: Interpreting & Translation labs restricted to foreign language/translation majors; Master's/capped courses require email approval (p.9).

min_gpa_host.notes: IULM 80/100 and 90/110 thresholds on iulm.it apply to full-degree tuition waivers, not incoming exchange students.

instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=6

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=9
english_course_availability.notes: 2026-27 incoming Excel catalogue includes 135 English-taught and 53 bilingual IT/EN courses out of 756 total course rows (43 ENG + 29 IT/ENG UG; 92 ENG + 24 IT/ENG GR).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 English required (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, home-university declaration, or English-degree enrolment certificate accepted; Duolingo and OLS NOT accepted).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=6
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: English-medium home institution/enrolment certificate explicitly accepted.

host_language_requirement.value: B2 Italian required if taking Italian-taught courses (optional 3-week pre-session Italian course for EUR 200 / 6 ECTS); none required for English-taught courses.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=6

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall (host term dates): Orientation Jun 17/Sep 17 & Welcome Sep 18, 2026; Classes Sep 21-Dec 19, 2026 (Extraordinary Dec Exam Session for American-system students); Winter Exams Jan 8-Feb 13, 2027. Note: AUC Excel specifies Spring term.
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=4

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring: Orientation Nov 18, 2026 / Feb 11, 2027 & Welcome Feb 12, 2027; Classes Feb 15-May 22, 2027; Summer Exams May 24-Jun 30, 2027.
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=4

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral exchange students are exempt from paying tuition fees to IULM (unlike free-mover Visiting Students who pay EUR 2,000/semester).

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=14
est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2026-2027 fact sheet p.14 estimates a EUR 1,200/month Milan living budget.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=14
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from EUR 1,200/month converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); math: 1,200 * 5 * 1.1052 = 6,631.20 USD (approx. USD 6,631).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory health insurance coverage required; optional 3-week pre-session Italian course EUR 200 (6 ECTS); no IULM tuition for exchange students.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=5
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Health insurance on p.5 and p.15; Italian course fee EUR 200 on p.8.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=16
housing_availability.notes: Very limited residence double rooms (EUR 2,820/semester + EUR 500 deposit); IULM provides no private housing search support and most incoming exchange students arrange private off-campus accommodation.

housing_notes.value: Limited campus residence double rooms at EUR 2,820/semester plus EUR 500 deposit; no university private housing placement support.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=16

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: DSU/merit tuition waivers on iulm.it apply to enrolled degree-seeking students, not incoming bilateral exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students require an Italian entry visa, Tax Code (Codice Fiscale), valid health insurance, and Permesso di Soggiorno application within 8 days of arrival; exact consulate lead time and financial proof amounts not stated.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=15

exchange_page_url.notes: Official incoming exchange URL also reachable via https://www.iulm.it/en/international/international-students/incoming-students.

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=9

english_course_list_url.notes: No direct English-filtered URL; use live portal https://iulm.coursecatalogue.cineca.it/cerca-offerta (filter by teaching language) or the incoming Excel catalogue (2026-27 file lists 135 English and 53 IT/EN courses across 756 rows).

credit_system_and_load.value: CFU (= ECTS); maximum 30 ECTS/semester for incoming exchange students.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/International University of Language and Media Arts Milan (IULM)/2026-2027/Factsheet a.y. 2026-27 - Partners with American system__1lUf2m.pdf#page=9
credit_system_and_load.notes: Max 30 ECTS on p.9; CFU=ECTS and 18-30/30 grading scale on p.12.

course_restrictions_note.notes: Course restrictions p.9; extension rules p.13.

academic_style.notes: Extraordinary Dec exam session on p.4; grading scale on p.12.

city_tier.notes: Milan is a major Italian urban center; exact schema city_tier label not explicitly classified in fact sheet.

campus_type.notes: Single 7-building urban campus in Milan connected via the IULM M2 metro stop.

international_support_services.value: Welcome/orientation days, 3-week pre-session Italian course (EUR 200), ESN IULM buddy/student network, YesMilano guidance, and campus tutoring/counseling.
